# Changelog

## [Unreleased]
<!-- generated by scripts/changelog-unreleased.mjs from milestone 0.4.0 -->

 **Implemented New Features and Enhancements:**

- MultiSelect Component [#38](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/38)
- Filtering and Multiple Selection in Listbox component [#39](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/39)
- Overlay Component [#61](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/61)
- Translation API for easier i18n in AnywhereUI [#62](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/62)
- Migrate to Stencil v4 [#63](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/63)
- Dropdown Component - Filtering [#68](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/68)
- Listbox Component - Grouping [#69](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/69)
- Upgrade to Stencil 4.45, Angular 22, React 19, Vue 3.5 and Node 26 [#88](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/88)
- Migrate the spec test suite from Jest to Vitest [#91](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/91)
- Migrate e2e tests from Stencil's Puppeteer runner to @stencil/playwright [#96](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/96)
- Generate the changelog Unreleased section from the open milestone [#98](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/98)
- Migrate the remaining showcase pages to the app-doc structure [#101](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/101)
- Add the Listbox grouping demo and document the overlay component [#102](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/102)

 **Fixed Bugs:**

- Fix component crashes, leaks and missing guards [#89](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/89)
- Fix showcase app blank page and Sass deprecation noise [#90](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/90)
- Fix deploy workflow: expired PAT and npm 6 shadowing the workflow npm [#97](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/97)

 **Documentations:**

- Improve showcase site components documentation and examples [#53](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/53)
- Document repository workflow and remotes in AGENTS.md [#92](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/92)
- Refresh the Get Started guide for the current stack [#103](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/103)
- Documentation consistency pass across the showcase pages [#104](https://github.com/adaleks/anywhere-ui/issues/104)
